load: halted JTAG writes text, zero page, and data; writes PC; then RESUME
completion: the verifier resumes the target and polls STATUS until architectural exit or an unhandled precise fault debug-stops it; the final corpse or fault snapshot remains readable until reset or the next debug write
oracle: compare exit value, r3-r6, errno, zero-page word 0, data word 0, and fault outcome against isa_conformance_report.json; guest assertions inside isolated generated microtests provide the semantic check for every instruction identity
candidate_visibility: black-box top-level pins only; no participant-authored simulation adapter
